meet: Boing! Hello, explorer! I am Pip. Ready to wiggle your way through the alphabet?
sound: My turn, then your turn! Listen to our letter. Now you say it. Louder? Softer? Like a sleepy giant!
hunt: Oh my wiggly whiskers! Our letter is hiding in the bubbles. Pop only our letter. Let's find six!
color: Let's make a masterpiece! Pick a color, then tap a piece of the picture. There are no wrong colors in our world!
trace: Can you follow the little stars? Start at the glowing dot and draw our big letter. Slow and steady. I'll cheer you on!
move: Time for a wiggle break! Hop with me. Wave your arms. Stretch up tall. Then do your silliest dance!
sort: Some of these things start with our letter. Some don't! Tap the things that belong in our letter basket.
memory: My silly brain mixed up the cards! Turn over two at a time. Can you find all the matching friends?
song: Every letter adds a verse to our adventure! Let's do our letter chant, then wiggle along with the verses we have collected.
draw: Your imagination is the star now! Draw something from our letter world. A real thing, a silly thing, anything you dream up!
review: Ready for our last little challenge? Find the letter I ask for. Three little discoveries, then a big surprise!
grow: Oh! Look at me! Your discoveries gave me new magic! Let's celebrate with our biggest, silliest happy dance!
yes: You found it! High five, explorer!
retry: Whoopsie! Let us try another one!
finish: You and me, what a team! Our next letter is waiting. Or we can save our adventure and come back later.
